Low angle at track level on an empty Mumbai railway platform at night in heavy rain: a white and purple Mumbai suburban local train arrives, its single bright headlight blooming, rain lit like needles. A lone small figure of a nurse in a grey cardigan stands at the platform edge.

Eerie cold blue light, no people.
